definition: Property rights: the rights to own, use, profit from, and dispose of property. In the Journey to the West world, unclear artifact ownership causes plot conflicts
core_question: Is the Diamond Snare Laozi's personal property, or a public asset of the Heavenly Court? Is the Purple Gold Red Gourd Laozi's private property, or a fixed asset of the alchemy system?

artifact_inventory.creation_context: Privately forged by Laozi · transformed into a weapon while converting the barbarians

usage_history.event: Used by Laozi while converting the barbarians
Carried by the Green Ox Spirit when descending to earth
Thrown at Wukong when he wreaked havoc in the Heavenly Palace

artifact_inventory.property_dispute: Personally forged by Laozi · but requisitioned for Heavenly Court defense · mixed ownership
artifact_inventory.legal_risk: The Green Ox Spirit used the Diamond Snare after descending to earth · is Laozi liable for the Green Ox Spirit's damage?

artifact_inventory.actual_property_type: private property · but used by the boys after descending to earth
artifact_inventory.creation_context: Used by Laozi to hold pills · an accessory tool of the alchemy room

usage_history.event: Stolen by the Gold Horn and Silver Horn when they descended to earth
Used to trap Sun Wukong

artifact_inventory.property_dispute: The Purple Gold Red Gourd is an alchemy-room tool, and Gold Horn and Silver Horn are furnace-watching boys · ownership belongs to Laozi
artifact_inventory.legal_risk: The boys descended to earth and misappropriated the artifact · is Laozi liable for the boys' damage?

artifact_inventory.actual_property_type: private property · but with a 'public-use' dispute
artifact_inventory.creation_context: Left over from Nuwa mending the sky · inherited by Princess Iron Fan

usage_history.event: Used by Princess Iron Fan to quell Flaming Mountain
Wukong borrowed the Banana Leaf Fan three times
The Bull Demon King stole it and disguised himself as Zhu Bajie to get it back

artifact_inventory.property_dispute: Although the Banana Leaf Fan is Princess Iron Fan's private property, it is used for a 'public purpose' (quelling Flaming Mountain) · ownership and usage rights are separated
artifact_inventory.legal_risk: Does the Banana Leaf Fan's 'public use' confer usage rights? Can Princess Iron Fan refuse?

artifact_inventory.creation_context: The sea-pacifying needle from Yu the Great's flood control · kept by the dragon king

usage_history.event: Used by Yu the Great in flood control
Kept by the East Sea Dragon King
Wukong 'borrowed' it and never returned it

artifact_inventory.property_dispute: The Golden Cudgel was originally a state-owned asset (the sea-pacifying needle) · Wukong 'borrowed' it and never returned it · who owns it now?
artifact_inventory.legal_risk: Wukong 'borrowed' it and never returned it · does this constitute theft? Why does the dragon king not demand it back?

artifact_inventory.actual_property_type: state-owned asset · granted by the Heavenly Court
artifact_inventory.creation_context: Bestowed by the Heavenly Court · granted when Zhu Bajie served as Marshal Tianpeng

usage_history.event: The Heavenly Court granted it to Marshal Tianpeng
Still held by Zhu Bajie after his banishment to the mortal realm

artifact_inventory.property_dispute: The Nine-Tooth Rake was originally a Heavenly Court grant · should Zhu Bajie return it after his demotion?
artifact_inventory.legal_risk: Should a demoted official return granted items?

artifact_inventory.actual_property_type: Vulture Peak state-owned asset · delegated to Guanyin to exercise usage rights
artifact_inventory.creation_context: Given by the Tathāgata Buddha to Guanyin · Guanyin passed it to Tang Sanzang

usage_history.event: The Tathāgata gave it to Guanyin
Guanyin passed it to Tang Sanzang
Tang Sanzang used it on Wukong

artifact_inventory.property_dispute: The Golden Hoop Mantra's ownership belongs to the Tathāgata · usage rights belong to Tang Sanzang · Wukong has no rights at all
artifact_inventory.legal_risk: As Tang Sanzang exercises usage rights, can Wukong claim 'personal rights' in opposition?

artifact_inventory.actual_property_type: Vulture Peak state-owned asset · 'carried' down to earth by the Great Peng
artifact_inventory.creation_context: A Vulture Peak artifact · carried by the Great Peng when descending to earth

usage_history.event: Carried by the Great Peng when descending to earth
Used to trap Sun Wukong

artifact_inventory.property_dispute: The Yin-Yang Bottle is a Vulture Peak artifact · carried by the Great Peng when descending to earth · does this constitute theft?
artifact_inventory.legal_risk: A Vulture Peak artifact was misappropriated by a mount descending to earth · is Vulture Peak liable for the Great Peng's damage?

artifact_inventory.actual_property_type: private property · but with a 'public use'

usage_history.event: Used by Guanyin to subdue Red Boy
Used to hold the waters of the four seas

artifact_inventory.property_dispute: The Jade Pure Bottle is Guanyin's private property · but used for 'official-duty purposes' · ownership and usage rights are mixed
artifact_inventory.legal_risk: Guanyin's private artifact is used for official duties · how are ownership and usage rights distinguished?

property_rights_insights: Artifact ownership in the Journey to the West world is broadly unclear · 5 of the 8 major artifacts have ambiguous ownership
State-owned assets (Golden Cudgel / Nine-Tooth Rake) are 'borrowed and never returned' by individuals · with no recourse mechanism
Private artifacts (Diamond Snare / Purple Gold Red Gourd) are misappropriated by mounts/boys descending to earth · with the original owners exempted
The boundary between public use and private property is blurred (Banana Leaf Fan / Jade Pure Bottle) · usage-rights transfer is chaotic
Artifact ownership in the Journey to the West world is essentially 'use is ownership' · with no formal property system
8 artifacts · all compensation amounts are 0 · victims of property disputes receive no compensation

property_rights_types.private_pure: Purely private property (Purple Gold Red Gourd / Jade Pure Bottle)
property_rights_types.public_pure: Purely public asset (Golden Cudgel / Nine-Tooth Rake)
property_rights_types.mixed_ownership: Mixed ownership (Diamond Snare · personal invention + official-duty use)
property_rights_types.delegated_use: Delegated use (Golden Hoop Mantra · Tathāgata delegated to Guanyin delegated to Tang Sanzang)
property_rights_types.usucaption: Use-as-ownership (Golden Cudgel · Wukong borrowed and never returned)
